task.description: Gate docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-005.md per WF-02 Step 3b. Read the spec independently. TEST-DESIGNER claims every script/curl/node/npm command was actually executed during authoring against the real repo state (not speculative) -- this matters because REQ-004's spec previously had a fabricated-expected-value defect (ISS pattern), caught downstream by RELEASE-VALIDATOR. Re-run several of the spec's commands yourself against the actual files to confirm they are not speculative. Check coverage of all 6 REQ-005 acceptance criteria, no TODO, and precision.
acceptance_criteria: Every REQ-005 acceptance criterion has at least one verification case (a)
No TODO left in the spec (b)
Each case is precise enough to run without judgment (c)
At least 3 of the spec's script/curl commands independently re-run and confirmed to match the spec's stated 'Expected' output exactly

result.summary: Independently read docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-005.md and re-derived the verdict rather than trusting TEST-DESIGNER's self-report. Coverage check (a): all 6 requirement acceptance criteria (locales array; messages/kk.json key-set+non-empty; /kk lang attr with /ru,/uz,/en unregressed; LocaleSwitcher four options+navigation+anchors; npm run build clean; /kk full-section render with no missing-key errors) each map to >=1 case (AC1-AC6, AC2b is a bonus precision case, not a gap). No-TODO check (b): grep for 'TODO' across the file returned zero matches. Precision check (c): every case names an exact route/script, exact viewport (600px/1024px) or explicit N/A with justification, exact theme or explicit N/A with justification (justified against docs/agents/design/REQ-005.md and docs/guides/qa_testing_guide.md, not just asserted), and an exact expected string/output -- no case relies on a 'looks right' judgment call. Re-ran 8 of the spec's commands independently against the real repo/build/server (exceeds the 3-4 minimum): (1) AC1 direct read of src/i18n/routing.ts -- matched exactly. (2) AC2's node leaf-key-comparison script -- output ru_count=177, kk_count=177, missing=[], extra=[], empty=[] -- matched exactly. (3) AC2b's node verbatim-diff script -- output diff_keys=[], kk_ogLocale='ru_RU', ru_ogLocale='ru_RU' -- matched exactly. (4) npm run build -- exit 0, '✓ Compiled successfully', route listing containing 'ƒ /[locale]' and 'ƒ Proxy (Middleware)', no error lines -- matched AC5's claimed output exactly. (5) AC3's curl checks against a real npm run start server on all of /kk, /ru, /uz, /en, root '/', /xx, /ru/xx -- every lang attribute, redirect target, and status code matched the spec's claimed values exactly. (6) AC4's curl checks of the '.lang' switcher markup on /ru, /kk, /uz, /en -- all four markup strings (link order, class=on placement, hrefLang attributes) matched exactly. (7) AC6's MISSING_MESSAGE grep count on /kk -- 0, matched. (8) AC6's section-anchor id= grep on /kk -- returned about/events/grid/join/map/partners/proof/streams/team/top, matched the spec's claimed set exactly; fetched HTML was 85689 bytes, matching the spec's stated byte count exactly. No discrepancy found in any re-run command -- no fabricated-expected-value defect of the REQ-004 pattern present here. Also independently confirmed the cited globals.css media-query line numbers (247, 256) via grep -- matched. Server process cleanly stopped after checks (verified via netstat -- no LISTENING socket on 3000 remained, only TIME_WAIT).
